en.meta_description: Bosch washer showing F23? Learn the verified code meaning, the safe action to take now, what not to inspect yourself and when to arrange Bosch service.
en.h1: What Does F23 Mean on a Bosch Washing Machine?
en.description: Bosch identifies F23 as an indication that AquaStop has activated and there may be water in the base or a leak.
en.quick_fix: Turn off the water tap immediately and do not use the washer until Bosch service has checked it (about 5 minutes to make the appliance safe).
en.intro_html:
Bosch identifies F23 as an indication that AquaStop has activated and there may be water in the base or a leak. This is a protection or sensor-related code, not a prompt to test internal parts.

Turn off the water tap immediately and do not use the washer until Bosch service has checked it. Record the full display and the washer's E-Nr for support. Do not remove panels, test wiring or order a part from the code alone.

causes_json.detail: For Bosch washing machines, F23 indicates that AquaStop has activated and there may be water in the base or a leak. The code identifies a system requiring attention but is not a complete parts diagnosis.

causes_json.cause: A model-specific sensor or protection event
causes_json.detail: The exact component arrangement and service procedure depend on the E-Nr and market. Use the manual and service information for the exact washer.

causes_json.cause: A persistent rather than temporary condition
causes_json.detail: If the code remains after the appliance is safely stopped, it needs professional assessment. Repeated resetting can hide the symptom without correcting the cause.
Wiring, sensors, valves, electronics and water-protection components are inside the appliance. Bosch directs the user to customer service rather than internal testing.

steps_json.detail: Use the controls to stop the cycle and wait for the drum to stop. Do not force the door if it remains locked or water is visible.

Turn off the water tap immediately and do not use the washer until Bosch service has checked it. If water is present, keep people away from the wet area and avoid touching plugs or sockets with wet hands.

If the plug and surrounding area are dry and safely accessible, switch off and unplug the washer. If water is near electrical connections, isolate power safely at the consumer unit and seek professional help.
Photograph the complete F23 display and note when it appeared. Find the E-Nr on the rating plate without opening the appliance.
Read the safety and error-code section for the E-Nr. Do not use dishwasher instructions or instructions for another Bosch washer series.
Give Bosch the E-Nr, full code and visible symptoms. Do not remove panels, test sensors or wiring, or continue running the washer to see whether the code clears.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Turn off the water tap immediately and do not use the washer until Bosch service has checked it. Arrange service promptly, and treat visible leakage, a burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat or electrical protection tripping as urgent.

A service technician should diagnose the protected system or sensor circuit. Do not inspect internal hoses, sensors, wiring, valves or control electronics yourself, and do not buy a replacement part from F23 alone.
en.prevention_html:
Install and operate the washer according to its exact manual, keep supply and drain connections visible and undamaged, and avoid moving the appliance by its hoses. Check accessible connections periodically for moisture.

Use the specified detergent dose and stop promptly when a protection or sensor code appears. Internal sensor failures cannot reliably be prevented by user maintenance.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing F23?
faq_json.answer: Turn off the water tap immediately and do not use the washer until Bosch service has checked it. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset F23 by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does F23 identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why should I provide the E-Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch model families and markets can use different hardware and service procedures. The E-Nr identifies the correct appliance documentation.

faq_json.question: May I test the sensor myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure internal wiring, sensors or electronics. Bosch directs these codes to customer service.

en.intro_html:

Pause safely, redistribute the laundry and check the drain hose and pump only as the model manual describes. Record the full display and the washer's E-Nr for support. Do not remove panels, test wiring or order a part from the code alone.

causes_json.detail: One heavy item or tangled laundry can make the washer reduce or cancel the spin.
The washer cannot spin correctly if it cannot drain the water.
Bosch describes cleaning a user-accessible pump according to the model manual, with a hot-water scalding risk.
If safe checks do not help, the motor, drive or electronics may need Bosch service.

steps_json.detail: Use the controls to stop the cycle and wait for the drum to stop. Do not force the door if it remains locked or water is visible.

Pause safely, redistribute the laundry and check the drain hose and pump only as the model manual describes. If water is present, keep people away from the wet area and avoid touching plugs or sockets with wet hands.

If the plug and surrounding area are dry and safely accessible, switch off and unplug the washer. If water is near electrical connections, isolate power safely at the consumer unit and seek professional help.

Read the safety and error-code section for the E-Nr. Do not use dishwasher instructions or instructions for another Bosch washer series.
Give Bosch the E-Nr, full code and visible symptoms. Do not remove panels, test sensors or wiring, or continue running the washer to see whether the code clears.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
Pause safely, redistribute the laundry and check the drain hose and pump only as the model manual describes. Arrange service promptly, and treat visible leakage, a burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat or electrical protection tripping as urgent.

en.prevention_html:
Install and operate the washer according to its exact manual, keep supply and drain connections visible and undamaged, and avoid moving the appliance by its hoses. Check accessible connections periodically for moisture.

Use the specified detergent dose and stop promptly when a protection or sensor code appears. Internal sensor failures cannot reliably be prevented by user maintenance.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing won't spin?
faq_json.answer: Pause safely, redistribute the laundry and check the drain hose and pump only as the model manual describes. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.
